You have about 2 minutes to book your trip with the BTR driver, else you'll be automatically removed from the vehicle.

Also via the BTR, PMCs may move items, that fit in a 2x4 container, from the raid to their stash for a fee that varies based on the value of the items.

All BTR locations:
- [BTR Emercom Base](#loc=400376)
- [BTR Junction](#loc=400401)
- [BTR Old Sawmill](#loc=400399)
- [BTR Sawmill](#loc=400402)
- [BTR Scav Bunker](#loc=397766)
- [BTR Sunken Village](#loc=400400)
- [BTR USEC Checkpoint](#loc=397769)
